description:
Test-first work item for issue 374 (`mol-refinery-patrol` rebase-skip guard).
Implements design section **D4** and builds the red-control capability.

Traces: AC-374-04 (primary), AC-374-01, AC-374-02, AC-374-03, AC-374-05, AC-374-06.

## Scope

Create `gastown/tests/test_mol_refinery_patrol_rebase_guard.sh` (CI auto-discovers
`gastown/tests/test_*.sh`). Witness-suite conventions: `#!/usr/bin/env bash`,
`set -euo pipefail` in the harness, `mktemp -d` + `trap` cleanup, `fail()` helper,
awk `lift_block`.

- **Lift, never transcribe.** Lift the step's fenced bash block whole from the shipped
  TOML using sentinel `git checkout -b temp origin/$BRANCH` (present in BOTH the
  unguarded and guarded formula, so reds are behavioral, not lift errors; it appears
  twice in the guarded text within the one lifted fence — use sentinel-indexed
  extraction). Execute as one unit. Mechanical substitutions only
  (`{{target_branch}}`->`main`, `{{rig_name}}`->`testrig`, `{{binding_prefix}}`->``,
  `<bead>`-style ids->`TESTBEAD`), then `bash -n`.
- **Execution wrapper:** `set +eu` subshell sourcing under plain `bash`; stdout and rc
  captured per leg.
- **Hermetic fixtures:** bare `origin.git` + consumer clone per leg; `git config
  user.name/email` in every committing repo; `HOME`/`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` redirected into
  the tmpdir and `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1` set (git 2.43 local vs 2.52 CI identity
  divergence; a host `/etc/gitconfig` must not leak). Fixture shapes: **EX-1**
  already-based/conflicting, **EX-2** already-based/clean, **EX-3a** diverged/clean,
  **EX-3b** diverged/conflicting.
- **Version-stable assertions:** assert the `SKIP-REBASE:` prefix and non-zero fetch rc,
  never short-SHA length or an undocumented git exit code. Exactly TWO scoped carve-outs:
  leg 6's `errored (status 128)` (the shim's own deterministic exit) and leg 3's rc 1
  (git's empirically stable rebase-conflict code; measured on git 2.43 — re-confirm on the
  CI git at fix time). Leg 5 stays `rc != 0` with 128 recorded in a comment as observation
  only; it must never harden into a third exact-code carve-out.
- **Red-control mechanism (build the capability here):** resolve the formula path
  witness-style with an env override
  `FORMULA="${REBASE_GUARD_FORMULA:-$ROOT/gastown/formulas/mol-refinery-patrol.toml}"`
  so the identical test file can be aimed at another tree.
- **Harness preflight:** `command -v jq >/dev/null || fail "jq required (halt leg)"`.
  The halt's wisp-pour pipes through real `jq` unconditionally (base `:273`), so the suite
  carries a hard `jq` dependency. Do NOT shadow `jq` in the stub PATH — the pour-id
  extraction must genuinely parse the stub's JSON answer.
- **`gc` stub:** PATH shim logging every invocation to `$GC_LOG` (the bead-mutation
  oracle); serves `bd show`/`bd list` canned JSON; answers wisp-pour with
  `{"new_epic_id":...}`; no-ops the rest; drain-ack inert but logged. Env
  `BRANCH`/`TARGET`/`WORK` and `GC_BEAD_ID` supplied.

## Legs (nine)

1. Skip preserves topology (EX-1, EX-2).
1b. Stranded `temp` fails closed at the skip-arm checkout.
2. Diverged clean rebases as today (EX-3a).
3. Diverged conflicting keeps the conflict path (EX-3b); cleanup `git rebase --abort`.
4. Fetch failure stops before the probe (stale-ref trap; then restore + re-run).
5. Missing source branch.
6. Probe error fails closed (passthrough git shim intercepting ONLY `merge-base` -> 128,
   real git resolved to an absolute path first; shim prepended to PATH only inside the
   lifted-fence execution subshell — fixture setup and assertions run with real git).
7. Structural backstop + ordering (static, raw fence text).
8. Halt composition: delete `main` on the bare origin; assert the park shape in `$GC_LOG`.

Leg specifications are normative in approved-design.md D4 — implement them as written
there, including every per-leg assertion and each documented *Red on base* expectation.

## Verification (both halves required)

- Static: leg 7's three count assertions — probe line exactly once; lift sentinel
  `git checkout -b temp origin/$BRANCH` exactly twice; the substring
  `cannot evaluate rebase ancestry` exactly twice. Leg 7 also asserts the lifted block
  contains both explicit refspecs, `ANCESTOR_RC=$?`, and the per-arm STOP literals
  `tracking refs failed`, `errored (status `, and `cannot materialize temp at origin/`,
  plus the full ordering chain and `bash -n`.
- Behavioral: legs 1, 1b, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 against the guarded tree.
- This item is complete only when both halves exist; a leg that drops its static or its
  behavioral half is incomplete.

Do not reword any pinned literal above — the harness pins and red controls depend on the
exact strings.

description:
Atomic implementation work item for issue 374 (`mol-refinery-patrol` rebase-skip guard).
Implements design sections **D1**, **D2** and **D3** in ONE commit.

Traces: AC-374-01, AC-374-02, AC-374-03, AC-374-05, AC-374-06, AC-374-07.

## Atomicity constraint (AC-374-07)

The formula change and the inference-gate repin land together. **Never formula without
gate.** Splitting this item is a contract violation.

## D1 — formula insertion (`gastown/formulas/mol-refinery-patrol.toml`, step `rebase`)

Pure INSERTION into the step's fenced block, between the halt's closing `fi` at base
`:293` and base `:294`. Everything from `:248` through `:293` stays byte-identical.
Order: prune-fetch -> halt -> guard-fetch -> probe -> case.

The inserted block is specified verbatim in approved-design.md D1. Load-bearing
properties:

- Explicit dual-refspec force-fetch of exactly the two decision refs, **exit checked**,
  failing closed (echo + `gc runtime drain-ack` + `exit 1`; no probe, no checkout, no
  rebase, zero bead mutation). Refspecs deliberately **unbraced** (`$BRANCH`/`$TARGET`) —
  string-distinct from the braced merge-push `:790` so the gate pin witnesses this site
  uniquely. Keep the fence comment recording that intent.
- The guard fetch MUST follow the halt: explicit-fetching a missing `$TARGET` exits 128
  and would swallow `target_branch_missing` into a generic STOP, bypassing the halt's
  park + escalation + wisp-pour.
- Probe `git merge-base --is-ancestor "origin/$TARGET" "origin/$BRANCH"` (target->source,
  quoted) — the string-reverse of merge-push `:795`, which is untouched.
- Capture by bare invocation with `ANCESTOR_RC=$?` on the NEXT line. Never `if !`
  (negation clobbers the status); never a zsh reserved name (`status` is read-only).
- Three-way `case`: rc 0 = skip (exit-checked `git checkout -b temp origin/$BRANCH`, then
  the `SKIP-REBASE:` echo); rc 1 = the preserved, unquoted, byte-identical
  `git rebase origin/$TARGET` preceded by today's exact bare checkout; any other rc =
  STOP, never read as "not an ancestor", never routed into the conflict-rejection path.
- STOP arms carry NO `rejection_reason`, no delete/reopen-source, no polecat reroute, no
  `gc bd update` of any kind.

## D2 — step-prose amendments (same step, nothing removed)

1. Insert before base `:298` the SKIP outcome paragraph (skip is a first-class success;
   do not abort, amend, reset, or re-run a rebase on it).
2. Amend the conflict preamble base `:300-:301` to the "and only then" wording.
3. Append one sentence to the step's intro rationale (base `:235-:246`).

Exact wording is normative in approved-design.md D2. Prose spells the token backticked
and colon-free (`SKIP-REBASE`) — preserve that convention.

## D3 — inference-gate repin (`scripts/gascity_pack_inference_gate.py`)

`GASTOWN_BUILD_WORKFLOW_CONTRACTS["mol-refinery-patrol"]` command dict (base `:122`).
Containment is whole-file, at-least-once, deletion-only (`fragment not in text` over
`formulas/<formula>.toml` alone).

At fix time **enumerate every `mol-refinery-patrol` site by grep and re-derive line
numbers; never assert a count** (at base: command dict `:122`, prose dict `:91`, and the
`setup_formulas` registry entry `:790`, which needs no change).

- Preserved pin that keeps matching: `git rebase origin/$TARGET`.
- Five added fragments, each satisfiable only by the new block:
  1. `git fetch origin "+refs/heads/$BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$BRANCH"`
  2. `git merge-base --is-ancestor "origin/$TARGET" "origin/$BRANCH"`
  3. `ANCESTOR_RC=$?`
  4. `cannot evaluate rebase ancestry. STOP. Do not mutate bead state.`
  5. `echo "SKIP-REBASE:`
- Fragment 4 is a deliberate two-site COLLECTIVE pin. **Anti-fix constraint:** the
  checkout-STOP arm deliberately does NOT carry this sentence and must NEVER be "covered"
  by rewording its echo to carry it — the pin would then witness a false statement. Its
  witnesses are leg 7's literal `cannot materialize temp at origin/` and leg 1b.
- The per-arm strings (`tracking refs failed`, `errored (status `,
  `cannot materialize temp at origin/`) stay leg-7 literals and must NOT be promoted to
  gate pins: `errored (status ` has one base site outside the new block (merge-push
  `:826`), so under whole-file containment a gate pin would be absorbed.
- Prose-dict survival: the second fragment tuple (base `:91`) must still pass.

## Untouched (assert in review)

merge-push in its entirety (`:790`/`:795`/ff-only/`--force-with-lease`), the
missing-target halt, find-work, the conflict tail, the witness suite. No backport to the
`reconcile/worktree-20260814` vintage.

## Verification (both halves required)

- Static: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_gascity_pack_inference_gate.py -q` green against
  the changed tree; grep each pinned literal in the changed formula.
- Behavioral: `bash gastown/tests/test_mol_refinery_patrol_rebase_guard.sh` — all nine
  legs pass on the guarded tree.
- `git diff` confines formula changes to the D1 insertion and D2 prose; `:248`,
  `:249-:293`, the conflict tail and merge-push are untouched.

All `:NNN` citations are base-tree (`05031f2c66e080865c379ff799c7369430560a8f`)
groundings and MUST be re-derived against the fix branch.

description:
Verification and PR-evidence work item for issue 374.
Implements approved-design.md "Verification at implementation time" steps 3-8.

Traces: AC-374-04 (red->green transcript), AC-374-07 (gate repin evidence), AC-374-06.

## Red control (AC-374-04)

Run the IDENTICAL test file against the unguarded base formula. Mechanism — never
hand-copy the formula, never edit the test between runs:

    git worktree add --detach <tmp> 05031f2c
    REBASE_GUARD_FORMULA=<tmp>/gastown/formulas/mol-refinery-patrol.toml \
      bash gastown/tests/test_mol_refinery_patrol_rebase_guard.sh

Expected outcomes, **enumerated per leg, never a count**:
- legs 1, 1b, 4, 5, 6 FAIL behaviorally
- leg 7 FAILS statically (its contained strings do not exist at `05031f2c`)
- legs 2, 3, 8 stay green

Then run against the fixed tree: all nine legs pass. CI keeps only the green side; the
behavioral-red capability is permanent in the file because the sentinel lifts on both
trees. Record the mechanism AND the git version(s) exercised in the PR transcript.

## Full verification sweep

3. `bash gastown/tests/test_mol_refinery_patrol_rebase_guard.sh` -> all legs pass.
5. `python3 -m pytest tests/test_gascity_pack_inference_gate.py -q` -> green.
6. Full suite as CI runs it: `for t in gastown/tests/test_*.sh; do bash "$t"; done` ->
   green (witness/heartbeat/polecat untouched).
7. Grep each pinned literal in the changed formula and **enumerate the matching sites in
   the PR body — never assert a count**.

## PR body records (design verification step 8)

The PR body must additionally record:
- the no-errexit execution assumption (a probe rc=1 must fall through to the `case`; any
  future errexit adaptation must use `ANCESTOR_RC=0; git merge-base ... || ANCESTOR_RC=$?`
  and never `|| true`, which destroys the trichotomy);
- the deliberately preserved bare checkout in the `1)` arm and its asymmetry with the
  exit-checked `0)` arm — the rc=1-arm wedge is pre-existing and scoped out, recorded so
  it is never read as an oversight;
- confirmation that no STOP arm pours a successor wisp (the missing-`$TARGET` halt alone
  pours);
- the **verified** STOP respawn source per residual precision (a): measure the concrete
  source (reconciler cadence vs poured wisps) against a production rig and record the
  finding, REPLACING the repo-evidence-only assertion. This is an external prerequisite,
  not a repo-provable claim.

## Verification (both halves required)

- Static: every pinned literal grepped and its sites enumerated in the PR body; leg 7
  green on the fixed tree and red on the base tree.
- Behavioral: the red-control transcript shows legs 1/1b/4/5/6 failing on base and all
  nine passing guarded.
